text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Civic Appointments Committee under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council Procedures, Appendix A-2, for a term of office starting on January 18, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
The Civic Appointments Committee: 1. Elected Councillor Cynthia Lai as Vice Chair of the Civic Appointments Committee for a term of office starting January 18, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022.
